_comment: Largest allowed absolute drop from evals/baseline_demo.json before the CI gate fails. The demo set has 70 retrieval questions, so one question fully losing its relevant section from the top 5 moves recall@5 by about 0.014 and two questions by about 0.029. A recall@5 threshold of 0.02 therefore tolerates one borderline question and fails at two. MRR gets 0.03 so a single relevant chunk moving down one or two places does not fail on its own.
